description: You received a $3,847 hospital bill for an ER visit. The file /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/hospital_bill_raw.xlsx contains two sheets: 'Hospital_Charges' (23 line items with codes) and 'Insurance_EOB' (what insurance will pay). Create a new sheet called 'Reconciliation' that: (1) identifies duplicate charges (36415 appears twice), (2) flags denied claims (99285, 70470), (3) marks legitimate charges as 'LEGIT', (4) calculates the true amount you owe (~$381) vs disputed amount (~$1,398). Add summary formulas at the bottom. Save the file (Ctrl+S).
